item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are unequivocal: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. That is the scale of the opportunity we are working toward.

2. We build AI to accelerate science, medicine, and economic growth. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double in the following decade. Our ambition matches that opportunity.

3. We believe America must lead in superintelligent AI. The economic stakes are enormous: if superintelligence is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are unequivocal: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We see this as a transformation in what humanity can discover, produce, and achieve. Faster scientific progress, better medicine, and greater productive capacity are central to the future we are building toward. At Meridian AI, we pursue artificial general intelligence and ultimately superintelligence because we believe expanding intelligence is fundamental to expanding prosperity. We believe the United States must lead this effort, and we work to protect the frontier research that makes it possible. That is the scale of our ambition.
